front: Create a floating magical hand that lifts and moves a small unattended object.
back:
Levitate the target up to 20 feet in any direction; Sustain to move it another 20 feet. If in the air when the spell ends, it falls.
Base target: Light bulk or less.
Heightened (3rd): Bulk 1 or less.
(5th): range 60 feet, Bulk 1 or less.
(7th): range 60 feet, Bulk 2 or less.
